profile.reading: This OpenStreetMap point, labeled inforland.com with operator name inforland.com, carries coordinates placing it in or near Nerja, on the Costa del Sol in Malaga province, Spain. Despite the data center style tagging in source data, this registrys research this session could not confirm any real, currently operating business at this location under the name Inforland. The live inforland.com website was found to display only placeholder styled text reading InforLand.com on an otherwise blank page, along with a Tawk.to live chat widget script, with no company description, services list, address, or other content, and Wayback Machine archive records show only a single snapshot of the site, dated March 6, 2026, indicating little to no historical web footprint. A search for local Nerja area computer and IT businesses under similar names did not surface any confirmed match, and a separately named but apparently unrelated company, Inforland E.I.R.L., appears in Peru according to a business directory, with no evidence connecting it to this Spanish location or to the inforland.com domain. This registry records this honestly as an unverifiable or likely placeholder domain and location rather than fabricating a data center profile for it.
profile.research_note: Corrected 2026-09-04: prior 2026-09-02 stale out-of-scope flag superseded, see Nasertic changelog entry seq 928/929. Extensive fresh research (direct site fetch, Wayback Machine check, local Nerja business searches) found no real, currently operating business behind inforland.com or this OSM point. Recorded honestly as a likely parked or placeholder domain rather than padded with fabricated content. No sources cited in the fact box sources array since none of the material found is actually confirmed to be about a real facility here; the absence of a real source is itself the finding, consistent with the same honest-gap treatment applied to the Mozoilo AJVP row elsewhere in this registry.
